standard.title: Legal Metrology — Commercial Capacity Measures — Specification (Second Revision) (विधिक मापविज्ञान — व्यावसायिक क्षमता माप — विशिष्टि (दूसरा पुनरीक्षण))
standard.sector: Light Mechanical Engineering / Commercial Weights and Measures

sectional_committee.name: Commercial Weights and Measures Sectional Committee

standard.description: This Indian Standard prescribes the quality, material, dimensional, and testing specifications for commercial capacity measures of both cylindrical and conical types used in daily trade transaction to ensure legal metrology compliance, measurement accuracy, and consumer protection.
standard.scope: This Indian Standard prescribes the quality, material, dimensional, and testing specifications for commercial capacity measures of both cylindrical and conical types used in daily trade transaction to ensure legal metrology compliance, measurement accuracy, and consumer protection.

certification.description: Mandatory Certification under State Legal Metrology Acts and Rules. Manufacturers must possess a valid license to manufacture, and each commercial measure must be physically verified, stamped, or lead-sealed by a State Legal Metrology Inspector to be legally sold or used for trade in India.
requirements: Observed or calculated final test values, dimensional parameters, wall thicknesses, and volumetric capacities must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2:1960. The decimal places retained should match that of the specified value in the standard.
Standardizes standard dipping cylindrical sizes: 1 litre, 500 ml, 200 ml, 100 ml, 50 ml, and 20 ml.
Standardizes standard pouring cylindrical sizes: 2 litres, 1 litre, 500 ml, 200 ml, 100 ml, 50 ml, and 20 ml.
Standardizes standard conical sizes: 20 litres, 10 litres, 5 litres, 2 litres, 1 litre, 500 ml, 200 ml, and 100 ml.
The body of the cylindrical measures must be manufactured as a single, seamless unit from aluminium sheet of specified wall thickness to eliminate leakage paths.
